benchmark: No NZ benchmark place lies in this region. Region-relevant checks: the Bathurst 1000, Parkes Elvis Festival and other events are rejected as occasions (Bathurst 1000 at 155,252 views is the strongest rejected); Mount Panorama Circuit, the permanent venue, is kept; the Carillon War Memorial, Lachlan Valley Railway (restoration) and Small Arms Factory (limited opening) fail the visitor test; no vehicle or operator is placed (the Dish, not a tour); Jenolan Caves is kept with its closure to early 2027 rather than dropped; small service towns (Forbes, Oberon, Grenfell, Blayney and others) are rejected with no named draw while Forbes' Plane on a Stick is kept as a quirky icon and held for a pin.
